title: Does Pinnacle Blooms Network provide any resources to help continue my child's therapy at home?
metaTitle: Parents Support and Resources for Home Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn more about the ample resources provided by Pinnacle Blooms Network to support and extend the benefits of therapy for child development at home.
html: Absolutely, at Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe that parents are crucial members of the therapy team. Therefore, we strive to empower parents with the knowledge and tools they need to support their child's development. We provide valuable resources including information sheets, at-home training programs, and suggestions for suitable toys and materials to use at home that align with your child's therapy goals. It’s our aim to not only involve but also equip parents with the best ways to enhance therapeutic learning at home.
